headline: US stocks set for a slightly higher open with bank earnings, economic data, and options expiration in focus
raw_text:
- S&P 500 futures (@ES) rise roughly 0.11%, Dow Jones futures (@YM) climb about 0.15%, Nasdaq 100 futures (@NQ) are roughly unchanged, and Russell 2000 futures (@ER2) gain about 0.18% ahead of the open
- Financials including Travelers (TRV), Truist (TFC), M&T Bank (MTB), Citizens Financial (CFG), and Regions Financial (RF) are scheduled to report earnings before the bell
- US import prices data are due at 8:30 AM ET, followed by industrial production at 9:15 AM ET
- Monthly options expiration is expected to be a potential intraday volatility catalyst
- Asian equity markets traded mixed overnight with the Nikkei (@NKD) advancing, while European markets were directionally uneven
- Oil futures (@CL) declined in overnight trading as gold (@GC) prices ticked higher
- Tech sector pressures from prior sessions appear to be easing modestly in pre-market trade, with few specific large-cap movers highlighted so far
